subject: Quick sync: demo slots that suit APAC and US attendees
messages:
From: Anika Rao <anika@novagrid.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Turner <sam.turner@novagrid.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request — interest in latency, multi-region routing

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for the quick chat via the website widget earlier today — Novagrid is evaluating options for inference routing and latency across US and APAC. We’d love a short demo focused on:
- multi-region routing and failover
- expected p95 token latency for typical 2k-token prompts
- deployment options (hosted vs dedicated) and pricing guidance

Our team is distributed across SF (PDT) and Singapore (SGT). I attached a quick CSV with our availability windows in local time. Could you propose a bundled slot that works for both regions? We’re aiming for a 45–60 minute session and would like an engineering-focused demo with an ops overview.

Attaching: Novagrid_MultiTZ_availability.csv (stub)

Thanks — happy to be flexible on day of week; mornings PDT are easiest.

Best,
Anika Rao
Head of Platform
Novagrid

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Anika Rao <anika@novagrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Sam Turner <sam.turner@novagrid.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — interest in latency, multi-region routing

Hi Anika — great to meet you via the widget. Thanks for sending availability. I reviewed the CSV and put together three compact, cross-region bundle options that should minimize evening/early-morning gaps:

Option A — US-friendly morning / APAC late evening (45 min)
- SF: Thu 2026-06-10 09:00–09:45 PDT
- SG: Fri 2026-06-11 00:00–00:45 SGT

Option B — overlap window outside core hours (45 min) — my preference
- SF: Wed 2026-06-09 16:00–16:45 PDT
- SG: Thu 2026-06-10 07:00–07:45 SGT

Option C — APAC-first morning / US late afternoon (60 min, more ops time)
- SF: Fri 2026-06-11 16:30–17:30 PDT
- SG: Sat 2026-06-12 07:30–08:30 SGT

Links: propose-slot (calendar tentative link): https://calendar.redwood.com/s/nikhil-sharma/propose-slots

Notes:
- We’ll keep it to 45 minutes unless you want extra time for a deep ops discussion (Option C).
- I’m adding Marissa (APAC SDR/solutions) and Aditya (solutions engineer) to the thread to handle timezone logistics and the engineering deep-dive respectively.

If you confirm which option works best and the preferred list of attendees (engineer/CTO/PO), I’ll send a calendar invite and include the agenda + an example p95 latency report for a comparable workload.

Best regards,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0129

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Anika Rao <anika@novagrid.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Sam Turner <sam.turner@novagrid.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — interest in latency, multi-region routing

Hi Anika — looping in from APAC side. Quick clarifications: are your Singapore attendees on SGT or IST? Your CSV had mixed tags. If it’s SGT, Option B looks clean from our side and keeps the session reasonably early for my team (07:00 SGT is fine).

Two small asks:
1) Can you confirm whether you want a short (15 min) ops Q&A after the demo? If yes, we’ll plan Option C (60 min).
2) We have a standing conflict for Fri 06/11 afternoon PDT — I’d prefer we avoid Option C unless you specifically need the ops deep-dive that day.

If Anika confirms SGT + Option B, I’ll draft the invite and include an optional 15-min follow-up with our solutions engineer.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead, APAC
marissa_cole@redwood.com

- Anika Rao (Platform) — anika@novagrid.com
- Sam Turner (SRE/Lead Engineer) — sam.turner@novagrid.com (please include his mobile: +65 8123 4567)
- Rajiv Menon (CTO) — rajiv@novagrid.com (may dial in)

We don’t need the extra ops hour; a 45-min demo with a 15-min optional follow-up is fine.

Attached: Novagrid_participants_org_chart.pdf (stub)

If you can send the calendar invite in SGT with an explicit agenda and the short p95 report you mentioned, we’ll accept. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Anika
